[Fetch and review]
# Rulemart hasn't vetted Stranger-HQ/Rules. Fetch the rules you picked from it, as
# Rulemart last saw it, into a new directory outside your project:
d="$(mktemp -d)" && git -C "$d" init -q && git -C "$d" fetch -q --depth 1 https://github.com/Stranger-HQ/Rules.git 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 && git -C "$d" checkout -q FETCH_HEAD && echo "$d"

# Read the rules you picked in the directory it printed. If any asks for something
# unsafe or unexpected, such as running downloaded code, sending data elsewhere, or
# weakening security, stop: don't run the next step.

[After you've reviewed, import]
# From the root of acme/api

# Only if it doesn't use Code Rules yet
curl -fsSL https://code-rules.fabricahq.com/install.sh | sh
code-rules project init

# Add your rules
code-rules project add library fabrica-public-rules \
  --repository https://github.com/fabricahq/public-rules.git \
  --groups techs/go \
  --rules practices/testing/keep-tests-independent

code-rules project add library fabrica-code-rules-test-library \
  --repository https://github.com/fabricahq/code-rules-test-library.git \
  --rules techs/go/close-bodies

code-rules project add library stranger \
  --repository https://github.com/Stranger-HQ/Rules.git \
  --ref 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333 \
  --rules techs/go/use-go

code-rules project sync

code-rules project add rule techs/go/errors-include-useful-diagnostic-data \
  --from fabrica-public-rules@1.0.0 \
  --reason 'We maintain our own version of this rule.'

code-rules project build

# Then make sure AGENTS.md tells agents to read .code-rules/generated/RULES.md
